comment: Shared overview vectors (OV-2..OV-4, OV-13) for sdks/rust/tests/workbook_format3.rs, sdks/rust/src/workbook/overview.rs and sdks/python/tests/test_workbook_format3.py. Each warning case gives the canonical-form lint's warnings, the 1-based lines where the bundled viewer renders an <ap-investigation> card (cards) and whether it can display the document at all (renders). html/routes/overview-vectors.deno.test.ts checks cards and renders against the bundled parser; the SDK tests check that a case without warnings has its canonical lines as its cards and renders. The generator builds the same documents in all three test suites: x = (x * 1664525 + 1013904223) mod 2^32 starting from seed; each document has 1 + x % max_blocks blocks; each block is blocks[x % (len(blocks) + insert_slots)], where an index past the blocks is the insert with {id} = investigations[x % len(investigations)] and {n} = its 1-based index in the document; each {w} in turn becomes w<document index>x<counter>z; blocks are joined with one blank line and the document ends with a newline; digest is the sha256 of all documents concatenated, so the three suites provably build the same ones.
